headline: Atomos Brand Monitoring Report for 2026-11-22

coverage.summary: DPReview has covered Atomos' expansion of touch-to-focus functionality for the Shinobi II monitor.
ATOMOS has released a tutorial video on pairing Atomos devices with the ATOMOSphere workspace.

visibility_gaps: GPT retail/product sources are treated as unverified leads, not new verified social mentions.
methodology: The search focused on retrieving original-source articles, posts, and comments from platforms such as Reddit, YouTube, DPReview, Blackmagic forums, RED forums, Sony camera forums, and videography discussions, all dated November 22, 2026. The search excluded topics unrelated to Atomos professional video production hardware, such as Final Fantasy XIV Atomos server, DJ Atomos, rap music, and ancient Greek atomism. The findings include product-specific mentions and product-agnostic brand comments, with explicit references to Atomos or AV PRO in the context of camera and recording. Each source includes the original publication date and URL for verification.
